Q1. What is a panoramic lift?
A panoramic lift is a glass-walled elevator that offers scenic views during vertical travel, enhancing aesthetics and user experience.
Q2. How much does a panoramic lift cost?
Costs depend on design, size, and customization. BG Elevators offers competitive quotes tailored to your project.
Q3. How long does installation take?
Installation generally takes 6–10 weeks depending on design and building specifications.
Q4. Do panoramic lifts require regular maintenance?
Yes, regular maintenance ensures safety and longevity. BG Elevators offers AMC packages for hassle-free upkeep.
